articles.summary: Phoenix Education Partners, Inc. (NYSE: PXED), the parent company of University of Phoenix, today announced it will host a conference call on Tuesday, July 14, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. MST (5:00 p.m. EDT) to discuss its results for third quarter ended May 31, 2026. Financial results will be released the same day after the markets close. The call can be accessed by webcast on the Phoenix Education Partners website at www.phoenixeducationpartners.com . Please register in the Investor Relations section of the site 15 minutes prior to the call. The call can also be accessed by dialing (800) 715-9871 (domestic) or +1 (646) 307-1963 (toll), using conference ID: 8113013. The webcast will be archived for 30 days and the call replay for seven days. To access the call replay, dial (800) 770-2030 (domestic) or +1(609) 800-9909 (toll), using conference ID: 8113013, or visit the Investor Relations section of the Phoenix Education Partners website . About Phoenix Education Partners, Inc. Phoenix
articles.title: Phoenix Education Partners Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call
